profile.name: Lokesh Sequeira
profile.heroBadge: Built NEXUS, a network incident intelligence platform
profile.intro: I build incident-management tools and reliable web applications with Python, FastAPI, React, Next.js and TypeScript. My background in network operations brings practical troubleshooting, clear communication and experience supporting real users to my development work.
about: I'm a software developer with over four years of experience in IT support and network operations. My background in incident response, troubleshooting and service restoration informs how I build reliable applications and communicate technical issues clearly.

I develop full-stack applications with **Python, FastAPI, React, Next.js and TypeScript**, backed by PostgreSQL and MongoDB. My recent project, **NEXUS**, is a network incident intelligence platform that correlates events, maps affected devices and supports root-cause investigation.

My approach combines practical problem-solving with user feedback: translating operational needs into working software, validating the results and refining the experience. I'm pursuing a degree in Computer Science & Engineering at Miami University and seeking a software development role where I can contribute my technical skills and operational experience.

projects.title: NEXUS
projects.description: An end-to-end platform that collects network events, correlates related device impacts, classifies incident severity, and supports root-cause investigation. It's built on the workflows I used daily as a NOC analyst.
highlights: Models direct and indirect device relationships to show what happened, when, and which components were affected
Investigator actions for investigation, resolution and closure, with timestamped state transitions
Historical records to help spot and review recurring events
projects.imageAlt: NEXUS incident dashboard showing correlated network events
